notes.title: Duskborn Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
New Features


  New effect Ground Bombardment can now drop from AJAX Dragonfly
 AJAX cutting prism effect will now automatically switch targets when the current target is dead
 Boss enemies can now drop loot orbs, that can be collected by the player to obtain their attacks
 Squidling seekers now predict the direction of their target, making them more difficult to dodge
 the duration of buff effects now also scales with the effectiveness of the trigger they are associated with.


Balancing


 nerfed OnCriticalStrike trigger
 health of stationary enemies (Angels, Annihilators and Bosses) now scales stronger with current depth, making them tankier when looping.
 tuned down strength of player dash
 Hydraulic Overload now also buffs jetpack refuel rate
 removed Winch Enhancer buff
 Exoskeleton Overdrive now also buffs grappling speed
 utility buffs now last longer

notes.title: Duskborn Chapter 2
notes.content:
Duskborn Chapter 2 is out now!

Duskborn is a university project developed at Stuttgart Media University over the course of two semesters. This update includes all of the progress which was made in the second semester, as well as the months afterwards, in which we continued to polish it and finished some things we could not get done during the semester. 
We spent this time to transform the prototype into a more fleshed out product with more content and a more satisfying gameplay loop, that encourages replayability and build variety.

We hope you have fun with it!

Patch Notes

New  Content


 New Map "Holy Ground": A second map to explore has been added, in which you will encounter new enemies, bosses and discover new secrets
 New Enemies:

 Carnivore
 Angel
 Terranova
 Squid

 New Boss enemy
 Rare and Elite Enemies: Regular enemies can now spawn as rares and elites, which gives them several randomized boosts to their stats.
 Enemies now have a chance to drop one of their abilities as "Effect items", which the player can then use to craft items from, effectively using the enemies weapons against them.
 You can now loop after finishing the game, which will transport you back to the first level. You will keep all your equipment when looping, but the difficulty scaling will also remain, so you will have the opportunity to really push your build to the extreme and fight against even larger hordes of enemies.
 The buff and ability systems have been overhauled to assist in creating all of the new abilities and effects.
Lore Logbook: You can now collect Artefacts that are spread around the map and by defeating enemies. These can be viewed in a special logbook, which contains a lot of useful information about them.


Balancing

 major rebalancing of enemy difficulty scaling and player scaling
 various parts have been added and removed and had their drop chances adjusted, so that you will on average find many more useful parts for your build
